button.title: Frame rate cap: 60, 30 or 15 fps for lower-end devices, then the screen refresh rate, then uncapped
Capture the mouse for camera control (F10). Esc releases it

xhtml:body.div: Keyboard and mouse work as on PC. Touchpad: hold Z for the middle button (paint mode: hold Z and move to turn the camera)
